 REGULAR AGENDA

 1.  24-53904  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the City of Long Beach as the
  Successor Agency to the Redevelopment Agency of the City of Long Beach
  meeting of Tuesday, January 23, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 2.  24-53905  Recommendation to adopt resolution declaring eight Successor-Agency-owned
  properties, known collectively as the Subject Properties, as “surplus land” as
  defined in Government Code Section 54220 et seq.; and authorize City Manager,
  or designee, to take any actions and execute any documents necessary to ensure
  compliance with the Surplus Land Act and State regulations thereto. (District 8)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  FINISHED AGENDA & MINUTES

 CALL TO ORDER

 At 4:45 PM, Vice Mayor Allen called the meeting to order.

 ROLL CALL

 Councilmembers Present: Zendejas, Allen, Duggan, Supernaw, Kerr, Saro, Austin, Ricks-Oddie

 Councilmembers Absent: Uranga

 Also present: Richard Anthony, Principal Deputy City Attorney, Tamela Austin, City Clerk Analyst.

 REGULAR AGENDA

 1.  24-53904  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the City of Long Beach as the
  Successor Agency to the Redevelopment Agency of the City of Long Beach
  meeting of Tuesday, January 23, 2024.

  A motion was made by Councilmember Ricks-Oddie, seconded by
  Councilwoman Kerr, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the
  following vote:

  Yes:  8  Zendejas, Allen, Duggan, Supernaw, Kerr, Saro, Austin, Ricks-Oddie
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Uranga

 2.  24-53905  Recommendation to adopt resolution declaring eight Successor-Agency-owned
  properties, known collectively as the Subject Properties, as “surplus land” as
  defined in Government Code Section 54220 et seq.; and authorize City Manager,
  or designee, to take any actions and execute any documents necessary to ensure
  compliance with the Surplus Land Act and State regulations thereto. (District 8)

  Enactment No: SA-01-2024

  A motion was made by Councilman Austin, seconded by Councilmember
  Ricks-Oddie, to approve recommendation and adopt Resolution No. SA-01-
  2024. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  8  Zendejas, Allen, Duggan, Supernaw, Kerr, Saro, Austin, Ricks-Oddie
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Uranga

  Mary Torres, Property Services Manager, Economic Development, spoke; and
  provided a PowerPoint presentation.

  Councilman Austin spoke.

  Councilmember Ricks-Oddie spoke.

PUBLIC COMMENT

There were no Onine Public Comments and non-agenda public comment emails received.

ADJOURNMENT

At 4:55 PM, there being no objection, Vice Mayor Allen declared the meeting adjourned.
